articles.title: Company Overview
articles.markdown:
# Company

**Pine Retail** is a direct-to-consumer apparel brand. Support covers sizing, shipping, exchanges, and gift cards.

articles.title: Shipping Policy
articles.markdown:
# Shipping

US standard: 3-6 business days. Express: 1-2 business days where available. International orders may incur duties paid by the customer. PO boxes are not eligible for express.

articles.title: Exchange Policy
articles.markdown:
# Exchanges

Size exchanges within 30 days if tags attached and unworn. Sale items are final sale for refunds but may exchange once for size.
